title: WHAT THE MAP FORGOT: the 0140 'complete' frontier map named 6 of 26 board records and misordered Mori vs [Z78L]; full 26-record board map + genealogy authored, off-board gaps recovered (Liu 2610.26835 number-fields, Arun 3/4-level affine public claims, open PR #52, Gao method atlas, OAI 11/12 program, Cureton-Thorner Dedekind 31/32); nothing beats [Z78G]; no in-tree change
body: User challenge: 'Find out what the map forgot.' Audited the 0140 'COMPLETE quasi-RH frontier map' against the live tracker catalogue (26 records fetched 2026-10-21; snapshot re-fetched after the 05:02Z pull: byte-identical values, top still gao-five-step-affine-20261020 = adopted [Z78G] 0.8748087). FINDING: the 0140 map named 6 boundary values; the board holds 26 records. The missed 20 + the errors, all now recorded: (A) THE FULL 26-RECORD BOARD MAP (theta ascending = strength; all framework-verified unless noted): 1 gao-five-step-affine-20261020 8748087/10^7 = 0.8748087 (Gao, PR #68, merged 10-21; ADOPTED [Z78G]) < 2 two-level-affine-20261019 174963413/200000000 = 0.874817065 (ArviFoxy, #67; [Z78T]) < 3 sil-uneven-normalization-20261019 874828524351/10^12 (Sil, #66) < 4 gao-balanced-marked-20261017 87483/10^5 (Gao, #63) < 5 no-hardcoding-20261017 874835173/10^9 (ArviFoxy, #64) < 6 gao-directional-affine-20261016 218709/250000 (Gao, #62) < 7 gao-affine-asymmetric-20261015 21871/25000 (Gao, #60) < 8 detector-affine-c0125154 437423/500000 (DaysSky, #56) < 9 radical-asymmetric-count-20261014 8748559/10^7 (timbalud, #50) < 10 marked-high-count-20261014 437429/500000 (timbalud, #48) < 11 gao-cycle61-plane-20261013 4374299/5000000 (Gao, #43) < 12 cycle61-c0125139 874861/10^6 (Collet, #42) < 13 certb-local-20261013 10935831/12500000 (Devin Watson, #53) < 14 gao-asymmetric-reserves-20261013 8748673/10^7 (Gao, #41) < 15 reserve-local-20261013 87486797/10^8 (Kari Roegnvaldsson, #38) < 16 affine-local-20261013 4374347/5000000 (Roegnvaldsson, #37) < 17 local44-20261013 87487/10^5 (nielstron, #26) < 18 cycle25-quartic-20261010 683505193/781250000 = 0.87488664704 (Collet, #9) < 19 akashlevy-20261009-weighted-numerator 10499/12000 = 0.874916667 (Levy, #6) < 20 nielstron-20261009-tightening 874957019420098946128603850561452983/10^34 (nielstron) < 21 proofcouncil-20261009 874957019421/10^12 (Gehrunger/ProofCouncil) < 22 liu-20261008 (1507 - 2*sqrt(921))/1653 = 0.874957069799168740... (Liu; the ONLY radical-form bound on the board; her v1 boundary B_L, confirmed as B_L by the Xu-Sang v2 HTML's own table: B_L - B1 = 0.0000703697991687..., re-derived exactly) < 23 argonaut-20261008 3499999/4000000 = 0.87499975 (Argonaut Math; the FIRST sub-7/8 record, 10-08) < 24 openai-baseline 7/8 (ADOPTED [Z78]; foundation) < 25 single-prime-29-33-20261010 29/33 (Collet, #8; a MILESTONE record weaker than 7/8 - the board also carries sub-frontier steps) < 26 classical-euler-product 1/1 (anchor record). NOTE the corrected ordering in the fixed-point neighbourhood (0140 got this WRONG): nielstron-20261009-tightening (0.8749570194200989461286..., 34-digit rendering of the bootstrap fixed point) is STRONGER than the in-tree [Z78L] certified upper 874957019420098947/10^18 (0.874957019420098947), which is weaker than proofcouncil (...421/10^12), which is weaker than Mori (0.874957020 - Zenodo only, NOT a tracker record, contrary to the 0140 map line), which is weaker than liu-20261008's radical, which is weaker than 7/8. The 0140 item (2) prose said Mori is weaker than [Z78L] by 5.8e-10 (correct); its map line listed Mori ABOVE [Z78L] (reversed). Both the wiki observation of 2026-10-20 and the 0140 entry carry the same reversed line - this entry corrects the record. (B) THE QUARTIC MECHANISM IS NOW NAMED: the board record cycle25-quartic-20261010 (0.87488664704) is the rounded certified rational of the exact infimum B_flat of a refined comparison system: B_flat = 0.8748866470399641309446140005301806... = the root in (0.874, 0.875) of 133488 B^4 - 376596 B^3 + 384534 B^2 - 167541 B + 26231 (other roots 0.4092630642, 0.5640155928, 0.9730321070); the board rational sits exactly +3.5869e-11 above the root (certified-rational >= infimum discipline); Xu-Sang B1 = 8748867/10^7 sits +5.2960e-8 above the root (their stated boundary is weaker than the system's exact infimum). Identity-verified provenance for the quartic: Liu, arXiv 2610.26835 v1 (2026-10-19, 'Zero-free half-planes for Hecke L-functions over number fields') - see (C). (C) OFF-BOARD ITEMS THE MAP FORGOT (all fetched + identity-checked per the 0138 provenance rule): (C1) LIU 2610.26835 (fetched arxiv.org/abs page, title/author/date/abstract all match): extends her cubic-theta argument to cyclotomic fields containing mu_12 and, by class-field descent, to EVERY finite-order character over EVERY abelian number field, and (using the mu_12-only analytic argument over F = K(zeta_12) for arbitrary number field K) the conclusion is every finite-order Hecke L-function over EVERY number field is zero-free for Re s > B_flat; the mechanism adapts the Xu-Sang averaged numerator estimate plus a limiting-contradiction argument and uses the local calculations of [Ope26b] (OAI's second, 11/12, preprint). SCOPE, not strength: B_flat = 0.87488664703996... is far weaker than [Z78G] = 0.8748087 - not adoptable for the zeta face, but it is the strongest published UNIFORM-ALL-NUMBER-FIELDS half-plane in the family and it algebraically identifies the cycle25-quartic board record. (C2) ARUN 3/4-LEVEL AFFINE PUBLIC CLAIM (via AGI Hunt 2026-10-21 aggregation of a public post; NOT on the board, NOT an open PR, NOT in the method atlas pending view as of this check): adding third and fourth affine levels to two-level-affine-20261019 gives theta <= 0.874812431 (three levels) and theta <= 437405141/500000000 = 0.874810282 (four levels), the four-level conditional on five structural hypotheses H1-H5 not yet proved in Lean (arithmetic exactly checked). Both values are still WEAKER than the adopted [Z78G] (0.8748087) - if H1-H5 are proved, three-level would rank between [Z78T] and [Z78G], not above; the pending band (0.8748087, 0.874817065) is now the watch region between records. (C3) OPEN PR #52 (fetched via GitHub API; the ONLY open PR): 'WIP: Collet's affine moment in the detector count gives 0.8748436 (Lean proof incomplete)' - liqsweep / blueberryvertigo, created 10-14, explicitly contains documented sorry steps, 'No check has passed, locally or hosted'; bound 2187109/2500000 = 0.8748436 (weaker than [Z78G] anyway); mechanism = Collet Theorem 2.2 applied a second time to the detector count's plain witnesses (slot capacity min(1/25, (B-2m)/lambda) for m in [41/100, 264/625]). Watch item, not adoptable. (C4) GAO'S METHOD ATLAS (issue #59 by Gaozhongpai, live at gaozhongpai.github.io/qrh-method-atlas, refreshes hourly, data snapshot fetched): an external frontier-monitoring tool with the 7-dimension proof decomposition (moment estimates / LOW / HIGH / detector-density / geometry-reserves / recovery-endpoint / verification), per-record dimension attributions (changed/reused/retuned/foundation status), affine-capacity comparison (slope and intercept B with local length window), a pending-proposals view (CURRENTLY EMPTY - no pending catalogue proposals as of this snapshot), and coverage of the OAI 11/12 program (the recorded saturating geometry theta = 11/12 - l/4). Also links cycle25-quartic's paper.tex at tracker commit d716ecaa (tracker main has moved past f07bb241 since 0142). (C5) THE OAI 11/12 PROGRAM (Ope26b): the second announced quasi-RH paper (49 pages, the only human-edited one of the 722 released papers per Quanta 2026-10-19; not yet formally verified) claiming Re s in [1/12, 11/12]; the community's human scrutiny focuses on it (shorter); it feeds Liu 2610.26835's local calculations and the method atlas. Ecosystem program, not a zeta-face input for us (we hold [Z78G] far past 11/12 = 0.91666... already in body via 7/8). (C6) CURETON-THORNER (AIProofWatch report, fetched): 'A quasi-Riemann hypothesis for Dedekind zeta functions' v2 - for every number field K, Dedekind zeta zero-free for Re s > 31/32 = 0.96875 (v1 had 1 - 1/6000); corollary for finite-order Hecke L-functions. A separate proof-council-style program targeting the full-Dedekind scope at a WEAKER constant; zero contribution to our face (subsumed by [Z78G] for the Dirichlet family); ecosystem note. (D) GENEALOGY (builds_on DAG from the catalogue - the 0140 map had none): openai-baseline is the root of everything. First generation (10-08/09): argonaut (from OAI), liu-20261008 (from OAI), proofcouncil (from OAI), nielstron-tightening (from proofcouncil + OAI), akashlevy 10499/12000 (from OAI). Second (10-10): single-prime-29-33 (OAI), cycle25-quartic (OAI + Levy). Third (10-13): local44 (OAI + Levy + cycle25); affine-local + reserve-local (from local44); gao-asymmetric-reserves (the three locals); certb-local (same three); cycle61 (OAI + Levy + 29/33 + cycle25); gao-cycle61-plane (cycle61 line). 10-14: marked-high-count + radical-asymmetric-count (cycle61 line). 10-15: detector-affine (cycle61); gao-affine-asymmetric (7 parents). 10-16: gao-directional-affine. 10-17: gao-balanced-marked (9 parents) + no-hardcoding (ArviFoxy, 7 parents). 10-19: sil-uneven-normalization (10 parents, includes gao-balanced-marked) AND two-level-affine (9 parents, branches off the Gao ladder). 10-20/21: gao-five-step-affine (10 parents, includes two-level-affine - the ADOPTED record). DIRECT LINEAGE OF THE ADOPTED RECORD: [Z78G] <- two-level-affine <- {Gao's 4-step ladder (asymmetric -> directional -> balanced-marked) <- cycle61 <- cycle25-quartic <- Levy <- OAI} + {sil-uneven, no-hardcoding siblings}. AUTHOR RACE (record counts): Zhongpai Gao 6 (holds 5 of the top 11 ladder records incl. the top), Hailey Collet 3, nielstron 2, Kari Roegnvaldsson 2, timbalud 2, ArviFoxy 2, plus one record each: OpenAI, Argonaut Math, Baiying Liu, ProofCouncil, Akash Levy, Devin Watson, DaysSky, Sil, classical-euler anchor. (E) CONSEQUENCES: NO IN-TREE CHANGE - nothing on the corrected map beats [Z78G] (0.8748087); the fixed-point neighbourhood records (nielstron/proofcouncil/Mori/liu-20261008) are all far above the face limit gaoD0max = 0.3748087 and remain corollary inputs only; the 0142 terminal ledger stands unchanged. Watch upgrades: the tracker watcher now also scans OPEN PRs (any new PR with a QRH-Bound is reported; a stronger-than-ADOPTED bound in an open PR gives early warning before merge); the method atlas pending view is a second queue to check. The 'external queue exhausted' verdict of 0140 is now REFINED (not reversed): board + arXiv + Zenodo were exhausted as of 2026-10-20; the live channels that kept the map honest are (i) daily watcher (merged board), (ii) open-PR scan, (iii) the atlas pending view, (iv) public claims (Arun-type) tracked as the pending band. No RH claim: the face hOffG is unchanged and is a zero-exclusion statement in the unverified region; all adopted inputs remain named external zero-free half-planes.
